en.How is music broadcast from a PC?: How is music broadcast from a PC?
en.Listen to the owner DJ's shared PC radio: Listen to the owner DJ's shared PC radio stream when online. If the PC signal is absent for 20 minutes, the station selects our official YouTube backup playlist.
en.The owner DJ broadcasts one shared PC ra: The owner DJ broadcasts one shared PC radio stream when available. Press LISTEN to tune in. After 20 minutes without a PC signal, the official YouTube backup is selected.
en.Our team programs the music. The public: Our team programs the music. The public player never uploads your files or changes our station playlists.
en.Primary source: the owner DJ's shared PC: Primary source: the owner DJ's shared PC radio stream. Backup: our official YouTube playlist after 20 minutes without PC audio. YouTube playback is independent for each listener.
en.The owner DJ's PC stream is our first ch: The owner DJ's PC stream is our first choice. If it is absent for 20 minutes, listeners can hear our designated YouTube backup playlist in the official player.
en.Our DJs choose several public playlists: Our DJs choose several public playlists for the PROMETEI rotation. Playback uses the official visible YouTube player, with its own controls and restrictions.
en.Listeners cannot edit the station progra: Listeners cannot edit the station program. A playlist may contain videos unavailable in some countries or browsers.
en.When the owner DJ is on air, every visit: When the owner DJ is on air, every visitor who presses LISTEN connects to the same live PC audio stream. The radio source is controlled centrally, not by each visitor.
en.No visitor uploads. No guest DJs. Only t: No visitor uploads. No guest DJs. Only the PROMETEI team chooses the music.
en.Automatic backup: if no PC DJ signal is: Automatic backup: if no PC DJ signal is confirmed for 20 minutes, PROMETEI FM selects our official YouTube backup playlist. When the PC signal returns, the station selects the PC source again. Browsers may require another tap to resume audio; YouTube playback is independent for each visitor.
en.We will not extract or relay YouTube aud: We will not extract or relay YouTube audio to our PC broadcast. YouTube remains inside its official embedded player.
en.Want us to play a song or send a dedicat: Want us to play a song or send a dedication? Share your request with our DJ team. Paid priority requests are planned, but no payment is collected yet.
en.This opens your email app with a prepare: This opens your email app with a prepared message. You still need to press Send. No money is charged.
en.We plan a transparent paid request queue: We plan a transparent paid request queue, with clear prices, secure checkout, DJ approval and refunds if a confirmed request cannot be fulfilled.
en.Payments will activate only after licens: Payments will activate only after licensing and payment-provider verification.
en.Paying will never mean buying access to: Paying will never mean buying access to a YouTube video or overriding music rights and platform rules.
en.When our DJ broadcasts from the PC, this: When our DJ broadcasts from the PC, this shows the real station-wide track history from the last 36 hours, with artists and titles from music metadata. Times are shown in your local timezone. YouTube playlist mode keeps a separate, local listening history.
en.The 36-hour public play log will appear: The 36-hour public play log will appear when our DJ starts the shared broadcast.
en.PROMETEI FM is a music page by the team: PROMETEI FM is a music page by the team behind PROMETEI Messenger. Our DJs choose the collections; visitors listen and send song requests.
en.Listen to curated YouTube playlists in t: Listen to curated YouTube playlists in the official visible embedded player. Videos may contain ads and vary by region. The embedded player is a separate session for each visitor, not synchronized live radio.
en.Yes. The page adapts to Android, iPhone,: Yes. The page adapts to Android, iPhone, tablets and desktops. Press LISTEN to hear the shared PC radio when online; browsers may require another tap after source switching.
en.Yes. Enter the artist, title and optiona: Yes. Enter the artist, title and optional dedication in the request form. It prepares a free email message to our team. Paid orders are not accepted.
en.The owner DJ can publish an authorized P: The owner DJ can publish an authorized PC MP3 stream over HTTPS to all listeners. Cloudflare automatically selects the owner's YouTube playlist after a 20-minute loss of verified PC signal.
en.Help PROMETEI FM, PROMETEI Messenger and: Help PROMETEI FM, PROMETEI Messenger and our future independent projects continue to grow. Your voluntary support helps us build, test and experiment with new ideas.
en.Choose the right blockchain network befo: Choose the right blockchain network before sending USDT. Donations are voluntary.
en.PROMETEI is an independent software proj: PROMETEI is an independent software project, not a registered charity. USDT contributions are voluntary, not tax-deductible charity donations, and do not buy song requests, subscriptions or special privileges.
